title: One failed chat-history open lasts the page's life: later turns are not saved to the cloud history file and nothing is reported, and the list and thread reads fall through to the server path
evidence: Done 2026-11-26 (US-15 AC76, Brad 26 Nov option 1): History after a failed read says "Chat history unavailable" (ChatThreadList.tsx HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE, from chat-turn.ts List failed), and a reply the history file did not take says "This reply was not saved to your chat history." (ChatMessageBubble.tsx; saveExchange in widget-src/src/lib/chat-history-save.ts answers unsaved, the reducer event reply-unsaved marks the reply). iPhone half: lead C22a. Was: Partial 2026-11-25 (R15, US-15 AC69): the open is one ChatHistoryOpen state with a pure transition (chat-history-access.ts); a failed open is opened again by the next turn, list or thread read; the website chat never reads the server path while a history layer exists. Words still owed, none added: "Chat history unavailable" where the History list shows a failed read (ChatThreadList.tsx shows the old titles or "No conversations yet"), and telling the person a turn was not saved (chat-api.ts sendMessage skips recordExchange when no store opened; nothing on screen). Was: Root fix R15 (triage 2026-11-25): chat history open is one state that retries on the next turn. Survey 2026-11-12 (main 5187412d5); Fable ruled 2026-11-12: never the server path while a history layer exists; say Chat history unavailable; retry the open on the next turn; report the missing turn (US-15 AC47). The UI thread builds it after its chat PRs (shared chat-api.ts). widget-src/src/lib/chat-history-access.ts getChatHistory keeps a rejected session; lib/chat-api.ts store?.recordExchange skips with no report. Also useChatState loadConversationsIfNeeded never retries a failed list
